evidence.root_cause: Converter maps U+00A7 -> \S in U_ENC/U_GRB, so manuscript '§B3' became '\SB3': TeX reads \SB as one control word and errors 'Undefined control sequence', silently dropping the §.
evidence.job1_sweep: Only 4 defect sites in the corpus, all papers/encoder-crossover-190/MANUSCRIPT.md:127 §B3, :638 §F.3, :643 §F.3, :653 §F.3. gated-read-batching/MANUSCRIPT.md has 0 §; replay-record-not-decision/MANUSCRIPT.md has 11 §, none followed by a letter. Generated scan \\[A-Za-z]+(?=[A-Za-z]) hits exactly encoder main.tex:62, :335 x2, :339. Of 38 distinct escape-produced values only \S is a bare control word.
evidence.fix: tools/package/md2tex.py: added CONTROL_WORD_ONLY = re.compile(r'\\[A-Za-z]+\Z') and rewrote Converter.esc to append '{}' when a substituted value is a bare control word and the next character's replacement starts with a letter.
